intro:
Study the scene, then choose!
Can you recall the hidden detail?
description:
Take a careful look at the illustration first, then answer from four choices what used to be in the hidden spot.
The rules are simple: just choose an answer and see how well your memory holds up.

How to play:

・Memorise the small items and their positions before time runs out
・Check the spot covered by the ? marker
・Choose the item that was there from four options

How accurately can you remember a place you only glanced at?
Each quick question tests both observation and memory at a lively pace.

Because every round is short, it is easy to play during a break or as a bit of brain training in spare moments.
Think it through on your own, or gather family and friends around the screen and discuss the answer together.

Recommended for players who:

・Enjoy memory quizzes
・Want casual observation-based brain training
・Are looking for a game that is quick to play
・Like working out answers with family or friends

Look closely at every corner of the screen and try to remember the hidden little item!

Supports both button controls and touch controls.
